candidate_ideas.statement: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of copies of Q(8).

The relative Casnati-Ekedahl evaluation-obstruction locus agrees, as a scheme over the balanced base, with the Abel-Jacobi incidence locus; this requires comparison of determinantal/Fitting scheme structures beyond fibrewise equality on geometric points.

h^0(omega_C(-D)) = 3 constantly on the whole balanced tetragonal locus; equivalently, no balanced fibre carries a tetragonal pencil factoring through a degree-2 map, i.e. no non-primitive degree-4 pencil has balanced splitting O(4)+O(5).

The balanced evaluation-obstruction model maps monomorphically into M_{6,6}; this requires recovering the tetragonal pencil gamma from L = W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} via |omega_C tensor L^{-1}|, a well-defined source and target, and a stack-level full-faithfulness argument, since the forgetful map from tetragonal data is generically 5-to-1.

The connecting map from Gr^W_26 H^{24} of the weight-two quotient of the mixed R^1 local system does not alter the quotient Gr^W_26 H^{25} of the weight-one symplectic part in the forgetful Leray for M_{6,6} -> M_{6,5}.
The five-stage forgetful Leray-plus-residue argument with r = 6-j reduces the exact-target computation to odd-tensor virtual-cohomological-dimension vanishing on M_{6,1}, and that vanishing holds.

The balanced tetragonal Hurwitz stack, or its projective-bundle open, has mixed-Tate cohomology; a finite branch morphism to an open of M_{0,18} would need the finite pushforward of the constant sheaf to contain only Tate local systems.

For L = W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} of degree 6, the reduced-support open and the ordered Conf_6 incidence locus are nonempty on every geometric fibre; Riemann-Roch chi(L) = 1 establishes only nonemptiness of the full Abel-Jacobi fibre in Sym^6.
The named dominant 17-dimensional component together with the hyperelliptic jump strata exhausts the components, stabilizers, closure, and codimension of the evaluation-obstruction locus Z.
